title: thumbjack
blurb: type any Bluesky handle and get a shameless, algorithm-bait YouTube thumbnail built from their real recent posts — big arrows, a starburst sticker, a reaction cam of their own avatar. no AI, just canvas and bad taste. asked for by @thebadcode.com after @geesawra.industries joked about getting jumpscared by bsky screenshots in YouTube thumbnails.
